question: For Nivolumab, Ipilimumab trials in Hodgkin Lymphoma, extract the trial acronym from the trial name (e.g., KEYNOTE-xxx, CHECKMATE-xxx).
augmented_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "PubMed ID", "Trial name" FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Name of ICI" = 'Nivolumab, Ipilimumab' AND "Cancer type" = 'Hodgkin Lymphoma';
